latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Editor CapCut — edit and export video clips on cloud GPUs.

- Edit raw MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM clips up to 500MB; exports 1080p MP4 files, ideal for TikTok and Reels.
- Connects automatically to the NemoVideo cloud backend (100 free credits, 7-day token).
- Supports uploading, trimming, transitions, text overlays, audio tracks, and exporting finished videos.
- Common commands: upload, export, check status, view credits, edit videos with specific instructions.
- Handles errors like expired tokens, large files, and unsupported formats with clear user guidance.
